Byte-by-byte Description of file: datafileC2.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units         Label       Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 18 I18    ---           OBJID       Unique galaxy identifier
  20- 28 A9     ---           HOSTID      Unique host identifier, can be used to join the host table
  30- 36 I7     ---           PGC         PGC number of galaxy, if available
  38- 48 F11.7  deg           RAdeg       Right ascension in decimal degrees (J2000)
  50- 60 F11.7  deg           DEdeg       Declination in decimal degrees (J2000)
  62- 67 F6.3   mag           rmag        Apparent r-band magnitude, extinction corrected, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  69- 75 F7.4   mag         e_rmag        Uncertainty in rmag, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  77- 83 F7.3   mag           gr          g-r color, extinction corrected, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  85- 90 F6.3   mag           rmag-fiber  Apparent r-band fiber magnitude, 1.5-arcsec diameter, extinction corrected, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  92- 97 F6.3   mag/arcsec2   sb          Effective surface brightness, derived from DESI Legacy Imaging
  99-103 F5.3   ---           ba          Galaxy axis ratio, taken from DESI Legacy Imaging
 105-111 F7.3   deg           PA          Galaxy position angle, taken from DESI Legacy Imaging
 113-117 F5.3   ---           Sersic      Galaxy Sersic index, taken from DESI Legacy Imaging
 119-124 A6     ---           TELNAME     Primary source for spectroscopic redshift
 126-132 F7.5   ---           z           Spectroscopic redshift, -1 if not measured
 134-139 F6.3   [solMass]     log(M*)     ? Log of estimated galaxy stellar mass
 141-141 I1     ---           sample      If greater than 0, this entry is a satellite and is repeated in the satellite table
